scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.check:api-contract: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run generate && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated && { untracked=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated); if [ -n "$untracked" ]; then printf 'Untracked generated API files:\n%s\n' "$untracked" >&2; exit 1; fi; }
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:api-contract && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
